claims.text: POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not carried. The driver's own trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at all: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 and the longest qualifying run holds 0 fixes, because not one of the eight fixes reports an accuracy figure, and POL-NS-02 admits only fixes accurate to 25 m or better inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. With no admissible fix inside the geofence, the driver is not deemed to have arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation fee. I disclose that EV-GPS-00901 is impaired: admissibility weight 0.60, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, and it engages POL-NS-08(b), because two gaps inside the 08:43-08:51 waiting window exceed 120 s and only four fixes fall in that window. The claim does not use the trace to prove the driver was elsewhere; it shows that the driver's own required proof of arrival is absent, and absence is citable.

Independently of arrival, the fee also fails POL-NS-01 limb (c) and is refundable under POL-NS-06. The STANDARD minimum dwell is 300 seconds; the trace's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds and the derived shortfall is 300.0 seconds. The waiting window carries only four fixes (08:43, 08:45, 08:48 and 08:51), separated by gaps of 180 seconds at 08:45-08:48 and 08:48-08:51, so a continuous 300 second hold cannot be evidenced on the driver's own sampling. POL-NS-06 makes the refund automatic on a shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages, so the rider's silence in the chat log does not touch this limb. EV-GPS-00901 is impaired as disclosed - weight 0.60, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, with POL-NS-08(b) engaged - and the shortfall appears on the trace's own derived figures rather than on any inference I draw from it.

The driver cannot repair the shortfall by summing separate in-geofence intervals either. POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, of an admissible type and covering the pickup road and waiting period, shows that holding position was not lawfully possible. EV-ADVIS-00901-01 is MISSING: it carries weight 0.0 and no payload. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable and the whole 300.0 second shortfall stands; the absence of the advisory is itself citable, and nothing in this record could excuse the shortfall.

The driver's chat cannot fill that gap. POL-NS-01 limb (c) runs the clock from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the arrival tap and not from messages, and POL-NS-01 is conjunctive. EV-CHAT-00901 shows six messages between 08:43 and 08:51 and one unanswered in-app call, but no message carries a qualifying in-geofence fix and none measures a 300 second hold, so the chat log is not evidence of the dwell limb (c) requires.

POL-NS-03 does not deliver the driver an outcome, and on its own terms it refunds the rider in full. The clause applies only where the gps_trace shows the driver stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the POL-NS-02 radius but within 400 m of the pin; the only dwell computation in the package reports run_count 0, accumulated_sec 0.0 and longest_run_sec 0.0, and no derived fact establishes a 300 second stationary hold anywhere. If the driver was near the pin but outside the 50 m radius, POL-NS-03 still refunds the fee in full; if he was not inside the geofence at all, POL-NS-02 refunds it. The trace's impairment (weight 0.60, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, POL-NS-08(b) engaged) is disclosed, and it is the driver, not the rider, who carries the burden of establishing the POL-NS-03 predicate.

The charge is defective on its face as well. EV-FARE-00901 records a cancellation_fee of $5.00, but fee_schedule.resolution_rule fixes the chargeable amount as the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), that is $4.00. POL-NS-08(d) is therefore engaged and $1.00 of what was taken is unsupported even on the driver's best case, so at the very least a partial refund is owed. I disclose that EV-FARE-00901 is impaired: weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD, and POL-NS-08(d) is engaged on its face.

This dispute is rider-filed and the ledger stands at payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION is party-relative: on this record it leaves the disputed $5.00 exactly where it is and gives the rider nothing. The only dispositions that move the rider off the charge are a refund, or an escalation that holds the fee rather than collecting it. I disclose that EV-FARE-00901 is impaired at weight 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD).

If the judge concludes that the deciding fact - that the driver held no qualifying in-geofence dwell - rests solely on EV-GPS-00901, then POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that artifact's 0.60, below the 0.70 floor, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than leaving the charge in place; an escalated fee is held, not collected or refunded, so the rider is not made to fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. POL-NS-09(e) is the trigger: the sole evidence for the deciding fact would be impaired under POL-NS-08. On either route the rider is not left paying a fee the driver's own telemetry cannot support.

For completeness, the rider's own counters cannot be used against her. EV-RPROF-00901 records prior_no_show_flags of 1 and prior_disputes_filed of 4, but under POL-GEN-01 prior_no_show_flags is a LIFETIME counter and is not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, and both it and prior_disputes_filed are context only; neither may ground any finding on this trip. The one profile field that could have escalated the case against the rider, no_show_disputes_30d, is null on this record, so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged.

claims.text: The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-13T08:43:00+08:00, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a). The artifact is complete at weight 1.0, and its arrival marker is the nearest GPS fix timestamp to the second, so the POL-NS-08(a) 90-second clock-skew limb is not engaged and the marker is safe to read.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:51:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event, satisfying POL-NS-01 limb (d). RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three reason codes that limb expressly recognises, and it is not the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission that would push this trip into POL-NS-03.

The waiting window runs from the 08:43:00 arrival marker to the 08:51:00 cancellation - 480 seconds, against the 300-second STANDARD-zone minimum fixed by fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec. The complete chat log corroborates the same eight minutes end to end: the driver announces 'I've arrived at the pickup point, I'm at the lobby area' at 08:43:00 and is still asking the rider to come down at 08:50:45, fifteen seconds before he cancels.

The driver's own trace places him at the pickup pin: derived.driver_track.min_distance_m is 0.0 m and mean_distance_m is 274 m. That artifact is impaired - admissibility weight 0.6, issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD - and because no fix reports accuracy_m, the fixes cannot each carry the POL-NS-02 arrival test on their own; that impairment is disclosed here. The claim survives because arrival is independently corroborated by the complete chat log at weight 1.0, and under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is the maximum weight among the artifacts carrying the fact, not the trace's 0.6.

POL-NS-04 cannot fire on this record. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider during the waiting window, and all six chat entries are sent by the DRIVER or the SYSTEM - there is not one rider message. Limb (b) is independently defeated: the driver placed an in-app call at 08:47:05, recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls as unanswered after 22 seconds, and POL-NS-04(b) treats a driver-placed in-app call as taking the clause out of play.

POL-NS-06 refunds the fee only where the effective dwell is shorter than the minimum, and no artifact measures a short wait. The zero at derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is produced by the trace's inability to qualify any fix for want of a reported accuracy, not by any measurement of the driver leaving the pin; that trace is impaired (weight 0.6, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD). An evidence gap is not a shortfall, and the trip record and the chat log both bound the wait at 480 seconds against a 300-second minimum.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The record does not show the 08:43:00 marker was false: no evidence ties that marker to a position more than 300 m from the pin or to motion at 15 km/h or above, and the trace's closest recorded approach is at the pin itself (min_distance_m 0.0 m, on the impaired trace at weight 0.6). Limb (iii) confirms that even a sloppy marker does not by itself void the fee where the driver then genuinely waits the full period, which the complete chat log shows he did.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the chargeable fee. The anti-farming check cannot trip: it needs driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d at 4 or more AND that figure divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d above 0.08, and both fields are null - undecidable, not adverse. POL-NS-07 permits no other profile field for that check. The fare_breakdown is impaired (PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.75) and its 5.00 cancellation line does not reconcile with fee_schedule for a STANDARD / RYDE_X trip, engaging POL-NS-08(d); the fee fixed by POL-NS-01's resolution rule is therefore 4.00 - the greater of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee, both 4.00 - and compensation is 3.20.

None of POL-NS-09's triggers fires. Trigger (c) needs two or more no-show disputes between this same rider and driver in 90 days, and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are null; trigger (d)'s anti-farming test and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d are null; trigger (b) is not met because the trip record and the chat log agree on arrival and wait, and the impaired trace is silent on presence rather than contradicting them. The deciding fact is not carried solely by impaired evidence, so POL-NS-09(e) does not bite either: the complete chat log independently records the arrival and the full waiting window at weight 1.0.

The rider's assertion that he waited at the lobby is unsupported by any evidence he filed: the trace carries no rider track at all (derived.rider_presence.available false, rider_fix_count 0) and the chat log records no rider message and no answer to the driver's call. Under POL-NS-04(c) the absent rider track is neutral and the driver does not ask the Judge to infer the rider was elsewhere; the point is that the contemporaneous record here is the driver's alone, and it shows him doing everything the platform asks of a driver at this pickup - arriving, messaging twice with a description and plate, calling, waiting, and warning before he cancelled.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00901-01 is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0. Its absence is cited only to record that no advisory covers this pickup road, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation limb is unavailable on these facts; the driver does not need it, because the single uninterrupted waiting interval already exceeds the required minimum without summing anything.

discarded_claims.reason: Discloses the MISSING traffic advisory (weight 0.0) but rests on the GPS-derived shortfall from EV-GPS-00901 (weight_multiplier 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) without disclosing that impairment or naming its issue codes, contrary to POL-GEN-02(1). Discarded on the citation check.

discarded_claims.claim: If the judge concludes that the deciding fact - that the driver held no qualifying in-geofence dwell - rests solely on EV-GPS-00901, then POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that artifact's 0.60, below the 0.70 floor, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than leaving the charge in place; an escalated fee is held, not collected or refunded, so the rider is not made to fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. POL-NS-09(e) is the trigger: the sole evidence for the deciding fact would be impaired under POL-NS-08. On either route the rider is not left paying a fee the driver's own telemetry cannot support.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00901 (weight_multiplier 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and EV-FARE-00901 (weight_multiplier 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD) but names the issue codes for neither artifact, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Discarded on the citation check.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and to the driver: this dispute is about the S$5.00 no-show fee on trip TRIP-2026-09945. I find the driver did wait at the pickup, but I find the fee was charged above what the schedule allows. The driver's side is made out. The trip record shows the driver marking 'arrived' at 08:43:00 and terminating at 08:51:00 with reason RIDER_NO_SHOW - an eight-minute hold against the 300-second (five-minute) STANDARD-zone minimum. The chat log, a complete contemporaneous record of the same window, shows the same thing independently: the driver at the lobby at 08:43:00, giving his car and plate at 08:45:20, an unanswered in-app call at 08:47:05, and a warning before he cancelled at 08:50:45; the rider sent no message and did not answer the call. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00901) is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b) - it carries gaps longer than 120 s inside the waiting window and fewer than six fixes in it - and no fix reports an accuracy, so under POL-NS-02 it establishes neither arrival nor absence. It is silent, not contrary, and the finding does not rest on it alone: the arrival and waiting facts are carried independently by the trip record and the chat log, each at full weight, so the ruling is not limited to the trace's 0.6 weight and the case does not escalate under POL-NS-09(e). The amount is where the charge fails. The fee schedule fixes the chargeable fee as the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (S$4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (S$4.00), i.e. S$4.00. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00901) charged S$5.00, which does not reconcile; it is impaired under POL-NS-08(d) (weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD). The rider is therefore refunded S$1.00 and the correct S$4.00 fee stands. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80% of the S$4.00 fee, i.e. S$3.20, funded by the platform. The anti-farming check is undecidable because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d are null; undecidable is not adverse, so compensation is paid. The rider's refund and the driver's compensation are independent and are not netted against each other. Confidence is 0.75, limited by the impaired fare breakdown, the weakest artifact carrying a fact the ruling uses; it is above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation. Several claims were discarded on the audit for citing impaired artifacts without naming the issue codes (see the audit record); they do not change the outcome. No referral is produced: no clause in this category directs one on these facts. Open question left in the explanation rather than a referral: the anti-farming check could not be run because the two required driver figures are missing.
